content.short: Fifteen (15) Dracanos were minted with the permutation "S1 Cx" (where x is a running number) for influencers and creators.
content.description: The Twitter account @DracanoArt was created and the first tweets sent out. Dracano Season One was minted and released on Tokhun.io and CNFT.io. Project Dracano is now verified on all major Cardano NFT Marketplaces. Dracano paints more dragons. Season Two is "Tundra Titans". One hundred and five (105) Dracanos are to be released to Dragon Chasers and Knights in intervals of 20-25 NFTs via relaxing raffles on the Discord. The artist reserves 3 dragons for private collection this season.
